summary: Validated CRM ↔ Memberships identity card on CRM Contact Detail. Logged in as owner@isodemo.com, navigated CRM → Members tab, opened Jamie Reed (qa-ct-mem): MemberIdentityCard renders with ACTIVE status badge, correct line 'Premium Monthly · Demo Head Office · joined 01/07/2026 · matched by email' and 'View member' button. GET /api/crm/v2/contacts/qa-ct-mem/member-identity returned 200. Then opened NonMember Tester (a contact that is NOT a member): detail view loaded and the identity card was correctly absent (0 elements with data-testid='contact-member-identity'). No console errors related to the feature.
critical_code_review_comments: MemberIdentityCard swallows all errors silently (.catch(() => setData(null))). Consider logging non-404 errors for observability (e.g., 500s would be indistinguishable from 'not a member').

Card renders status text via CSS uppercase; the raw value asserted via data-testid='member-identity-status' returns 'active' visually as 'ACTIVE'. This is acceptable but worth noting: the requirement said the status testid should equal 'active' — the DOM textContent is 'active' (CSS text-transform: uppercase applied only visually), so the assertion still holds.
CRMContacts.js is 1413 lines — consider splitting the detail view / identity card into their own files for maintainability.
test_credentials: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! (CRM login via /login page, then navigate to /crm)
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded contacts: qa-ct-mem (Jamie Reed, member) and 3c76cab3-... (NonMember Tester).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM contacts are shown under CRM → 'Members' nav tab (label 'Members' means 'Contacts' in Members-mode CRM). Two 'Members' controls exist on the page — the nav tab is the 2nd occurrence. Contact row testid: contact-row-{id}. Detail root: crm-contact-detail. Identity card testids: contact-member-identity, member-identity-status, member-identity-open. Non-member contact API returns 200 with is_member=false and the component returns null. Note: an unrelated 401 was observed on non-member detail load (not on the member-identity endpoint, both returned 200) — likely from an unrelated ancillary CRM call; did not affect the tested feature.
